verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents some bulk-ingest capabilities of its own: Spreadsheet Import, an 'Add Multiple Companies Using Template' support article, and cap-table migration from Carta or Pulley. These let many records be created at once. Beyond these titles there is nothing on bulk editing, bulk issuance, or bulk actions across many stakeholders or securities, and the import evidence is only listing-level. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete actions across items, bulk share issuance or grant workflows, API or programmatic batch operations, detailed docs on import scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
